1. Remove the negative terminal from the battery
2. Get another person to start from the inside and ask him to place the key in ignition.
3. Take the negative wire and touch and take the wire consecutively from the terminal, you will sense it will try to start.
4. At a particular time it would ignited and have almost started,at that time do not remove the terminal. and place it to the terminal.
This process also needs two people but you dont need to push the vehicle and waste energy, you just need the correct spanner to remove the terminal wire.
Make sure you drive for few kilometers after starting for the alternator to recharge the battery.
